description: Election Commission - A. Thaveethu was Elected as the member of the Vavuniya South (Tamil) Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Vavuniya South Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, and specifically declares a new member elected under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content focuses entirely on electoral processes and declarations, falling squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) which includes candidate nominations, registrations, and declarations of election results for local authorities.
